'''Kaja Honn''', also known as '''Prisoner #74631''' was a [[Human/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and the founder of [[Clan Kaja]].<ref name="Codex" />

She wasn't born Mandalorian, but raised as one. Upon reaching adulthood, she chose to stay with the Mandalorian, however she was almost immediately taken prisoner by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] after she was framed from stealing imperial supplies. Sent to a prison on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], she rallied and trained other prisoners who eventually began calling themselves Clan Kaja after her. Eventually managing to escape, Kaja died in the attempt, however her [[Shackle no.74631|shackle]] became an important historical artefact for Clan Kaja, which obtained full clan status some years later.<ref name="Codex" />
